newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CR Beijing Land mulls convertible bonds.
newsitem.headline: CR Beijing Land mulls convertible bonds.

text.p: China Resources Beijing Land Ltd said on Friday it was considering an issue of seven-year guaranteed bonds convertible into company shares, raising capital for its property development in Beijing.

"(The company) is currently considering an issue of seven-year guaranteed convertible bonds by a wholly-owned subsidiary of the company, China Resources Beijing Capital Ltd, in the international capital markets," it said in a statement.

"It is intended that the net proceeds of the issue will be used by the company primarily to fund the property development activities of its subsidiary, Beijing Huayuan Property Co Ltd," the statement said.
An application has been made to list the bonds in Luxembourg, it said.
The company said it would made a further statement when the terms and structure of the proposed issue have been finalised.

The company said Beijing Huayuan group had earlier in April agreed to buy from Huayuan Group Corp a 21 percent stake in Beijing Hua Wei Center Co Ltd for 121.1 million yuan, raising its stake in Beijing Hua Wei to 50 percent from 29 percent.
The company said the district government had also approved the development by Beijing Huayuan of two new residential and commercial development projects in Western District of Beijing.
"The company is also actively negotiating for the acquisition of other significant land development sites," the statement said.
China Resources Beijing Land, the spunoff China property arm of China Resources Enterprise Ltd, was listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange on November 8, 1996.
